entries.text_de: Die von Kolderup-Rosenvinge gedruckte Abschrift, jetzt zu Kopenhagen Arne-Magnaeanus 1, die F. Rostgaard († 1745) aus Cb anfertigen liess und 1697 damit verglich: In Cn, u. S. 612.
entries.text_en: The transcript printed by Kolderup-Rosenvinge, now at Copenhagen, Arne-Magnaeanus 1, which F. Rostgaard († 1745) had made from Cb and collated with it in 1697: In Cn, below, p. 612.

transcription.doubts: Kopenhagen is spaced in the German; I kept the spacing on 'Copenhagen' in the crib.
